description: This file implements the Linux-specific device identifier and configuration logic for the WPEFramework plugin, including interface configuration, MAC address retrieval, and device information such as architecture, chipset, and firmware version.

classes.name: DeviceImplementation
classes.description: Implements device identification, configuration, and MAC address retrieval for Linux within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: JSON configuration class that contains the network interface name.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: Observes network interface events and validates MAC addresses.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the device with provided service settings.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Returns the device identifier based on MAC address.

methods.name: UpdateDeviceId
methods.description: Updates device identifier based on network MAC address.
